data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool error (HTTP 400) in the qwen model when processing .nvchecker.toml, which forced an overall inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully processed the same file and found it to be a benign configuration.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .nvchecker.toml due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: The audit tool should handle transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) more gracefully, perhaps by retrying or allowing the overall verdict to proceed if the failed file is non-critical (like .nvchecker.toml), rather than failing the entire audit.
